chartsArray.title: Top 5 Largest Economies by Nominal GDP (2025)
chartsArray.chartFootNote: Data based on IMF World Economic Outlook (October 2025) projections. The United States and China remain the two largest global economies, together accounting for the vast majority of the top 5 nominal GDP total.

chartsArray.title: Share of Global GDP by Purchasing Power Parity (PPP)
chartsArray.chartFootNote: Adjusted for Purchasing Power Parity (PPP), China holds the largest single share of global GDP at 19.63%, followed by the United States at 14.65% and India at 8.48%.

chartsArray.title: Projected 2025 Real GDP Growth Rates of Top 5 Economies
chartsArray.chartFootNote: India leads the top 5 economies in projected real GDP growth rate at 6.6%, followed by China at 4.8%, while advanced economies display slower growth rates ranging from 0.2% to 2.0%.

otherResearchFindings: GDP per capita figures for 2025 place the United States highest among the top 5 at $89,600, followed by Germany ($59,930), Japan ($34,710), China ($13,810), and India ($2,820). According to IMF data, the United Kingdom ranks 6th in nominal GDP at $3.96 Trillion.
